basic_info.description: 2351 Washington Street is a 15-unit multifamily property located in the prestigious Pacific Heights neighborhood of San Francisco. The property sits on a prime block location being a block away from Fillmore Street and equidistance to both Alta Plaza and Lafayette Parks.     The building spans approximately 8,925 square feet on an 3,831 square foot lot and is comprised entirely of fifteen (15) studio apartments. The property also features three (3) dedicated parking spaces. Retaining its classic architectural appeal, 2351 Washington Street showcases period details throughout, including bay windows, ornate moldings, and hardwood flooring, reflecting the timeless elegance of early 20th-century San Francisco design.     Pacific Heights is renowned for its refined living experience, offering residents tree-lined streets, breathtaking views, and a vibrant mix of upscale boutiques, gourmet dining, and cultural attractions. The neighborhood provides convenient access to downtown San Francisco, as well as scenic vistas of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and the Bay.    For investors, 2351 Washington Street presents a rare opportunity to acquire a well-located and a mostly vacant asset in one of the city's most coveted neighborhoods.
